name: The Adder's Drafting Board
description: A tilted navigator's chart table for vector ADDITION. Drag two glowing tip-pucks across an etched integer grid: amber a springs from the origin pin, orange b draws tip-to-tail off a's tip, and the cyan-violet resultant a+b snaps from origin to b's tip the same frame. Faint dashed ghosts complete the PARALLELOGRAM so both constructions show at once, and a push-button flips emphasis between the tip-to-tail chain and the parallelogram. A floating two-column plate pens the arithmetic live (components left, substituting formula right), and a billboarded triangle-inequality readout shows |a+b| <= |a|+|b| with a brass needle that pegs to equality only when a and b go parallel. Inputs are grabbable; results never are. Part of The Vector Bench collection.
theoreticalGrounding: a + b = (ax+bx, ay+by). Tip-to-tail and the parallelogram are the same truth drawn two ways; the diagonal is the sum, and its length is bounded by the detour: |a+b| <= |a|+|b|, with equality exactly when a and b are parallel.

adder_board.name: The Adder's Drafting Board
adder_board.description: Dark slate pedestal with a brass rim and a black drafting slab tilted ~20deg toward the player, etched with an integer lattice and a glowing origin pin. Two grabbable GrabSphere tip-pucks set a (amber) and b (orange); emissive catapult-style arrows redraw the tip-to-tail chain + the cyan-violet resultant + dashed parallelogram ghosts every frame. Two precision sliders set |a|,|b| to clean integers; a push-button toggles chain-glow vs parallelogram-glow. Live two-column formula plate + billboarded readouts including the triangle-inequality |a+b| <= |a|+|b| with a brass equality needle. DNA: a_start, b_start, snap_to_grid, pedestal_height.
adder_board.qfep_connection: F_force: two displacements taken in sequence equal one displacement — addition is composition, and the detour is never shorter than the diagonal (|a+b| <= |a|+|b|).
